TWO PLACES FOR THE REPAIR WORKSHOP

What trade-offs do the two venues offer?
 	Station hall	Garden room
Capacity	48 people	32 people
Hire	€240 per evening	€160 per evening
Access	Step-free entrance, next to the bus station	Step-free entrance, 700 m from the bus station
Constraint	Tools and tables must be removed each evening	Tools can stay in a locked cupboard

All costs are provisional quotes for one evening; staffing and insurance are excluded.
